draw: npx tsx scripts/sealed-law.ts draw --precommit sealed/precommit-5.json (drawLaw in this script at the commit above)
run: npx tsx scripts/run.ts sealed/clips/sealed-<round>.mp4 --narration "a block on a spring, filmed from the side" --sealed (one run each; refuses a dirty tree)
scoring: hit: the winner's term set equals the drawn term set (stiffness, damping and drive terms), where a fitted term whose constant is within 2σ of zero counts as absent, and each shared constant is within 2σ of the drawn value; pixel constants converted with the render's own scale; a winner with an undefined (NaN) σ on any free constant cannot be scored a hit; anything else is a miss. A second, free oscillation whose damping is within 2σ of zero, at a frequency outside the motion's own band, counts as a drive term. Reported apart: drive recall (driven laws found / driven laws drawn), false-drive rate (undriven laws whose winner carries a drive term more than 2σ from zero, or such an undamped mode), and, for each hit and each drive, whether a model wrote the winning law (Muse Spark or Muse Wonder) or a code move made it (a drive added at an unexplained peak, a recombination, or a term added to the leading law)
